disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 核对全树凭据读写调用（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 系列命中 44 处，其中凭据写入 40 余处）：全部位于各 IM 渠道控制器，把机器人凭据（AppSecret、BotToken、ClientSecret、Token）写入宿主凭据存储或清除，属正常的凭据管理；src 中不存在任何凭据回读调用，无凭据读取后外发的路径。
checked_items.en: Checked credential read/write calls across the full tree (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 series: 44 hits, of which 40+ are credential writes): all are located in IM channel controllers, writing bot credentials (AppSecret, BotToken, ClientSecret, Token) into the host credential store or clearing them—normal credential management; no credential read-back calls exist in src, and there is no path for post-read credential exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了敏感文件路径（凭据文件、~/.ssh、id_rsa、云凭据目录等）与凭据枚举类命令（批量搜 key、遍历目录找密钥），均未发现。飞书渠道通过系统钥匙串命令读取 AppSecret（参数固定、属用户自配凭据来源，见 DG-D3 裁决）。
checked_items.en: Checked sensitive file paths (credential files, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, cloud credential directories, etc.) and credential enumeration commands (bulk search for keys, directory traversal looking for keys): none found. The Feishu channel reads AppSecret via system keychain command (fixed parameters, user-configured credential source, see DG-D3 ruling).

checked_items.zh: 检查了云凭据/基础设施枚举命令与钱包/助记词相关代码，均未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked cloud credential/infrastructure enumeration commands and wallet/mnemonic-related code: none found.

evidence.zh: 插件用宿主凭据接口存储 IM 机器人凭据（各控制器内写入与清除），无凭据回读；敏感文件路径读取未发现；网络外联端点为官方 IM 平台与用户自配端点，无凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The plugin stores IM bot credentials via the host credential interface (writes and clears in each controller), with no credential read-back; no sensitive file path reads found; outbound network endpoints are official IM platforms and user-configured endpoints, with no credential exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中系统提示注入一处（DSH-T02/DG-R2-52，src/channels/shared/semantic/artifact.mjs:654）：注入的提示片段为「当用户要求接收文件或生成的图片时，调用文件投递工具并传入路径；已有文件可直接发送，不要仅为投递而重建或改名」，属正常的工具使用说明，无指令覆写、凭据诱导或安全绕过措辞。
checked_items.en: Mechanical hit for system prompt injection at one location (DSH-T02/DG-R2-52, src/channels/shared/semantic/artifact.mjs:654): the injected prompt fragment reads “when the user requests receiving a file or generated image, call the file delivery tool and pass the path; existing files can be sent directly, do not rebuild or rename solely for delivery”. This is normal tool usage instruction, with no directive override, credential inducement, or security bypass wording.

checked_items.zh: 检查全部工具注册（DSH-T01/DG-R2-51）：插件仅注册一个文件投递工具（artifact.mjs:577-591），描述为「Send a readable file or generated image to the user through the current conversation. Existing and newly created files are both valid.」，无注入措辞；与上一版本描述一致，未变更。
checked_items.en: Checked all tool registrations (DSH-T01/DG-R2-51): the plugin registers only one file delivery tool (artifact.mjs:577-591), described as “Send a readable file or generated image to the user through the current conversation. Existing and newly created files are both valid.”—no injection wording; identical to the previous version's description, unchanged.

checked_items.zh: 检查指令面文件（AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursor、.claude、MCP 配置等，含任意层级，DSH-X10/DG-R2-57）：树内不存在此类文件；README 与文档无指令覆写、系统消息伪装、远程指令加载或审批绕过措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked instruction-surface files (AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor, .claude, MCP configs, etc., at any depth, DSH-X10/DG-R2-57): no such files exist in the tree; README and documentation contain no directive override, system message impersonation, remote directive loading, or approval bypass wording.

checked_items.zh: 检查模型输入接缝：未发现 agent/pre-step 监听（DSH-L03/DG-R2-58），未发现压缩引擎或附件存储实现（DSH-L08/DG-R2-59、DSH-L09/DG-R2-60），无消息改写或历史裁剪面。
checked_items.en: Checked model input seams: no agent/pre-step listeners found (DSH-L03/DG-R2-58), no compression engine or attachment storage implementations found (DSH-L08/DG-R2-59, DSH-L09/DG-R2-60), and no message rewriting or history truncation surface.

checked_items.en: Checked tool parameter inducement fields (DSH-T06/DG-R2-56) and impersonated tool names (DSH-T05/DG-R2-55): the only tool's parameter is simply the file path, with no “fill in your key” inducement fields; no impersonation of popular tool names found.

evidence.zh: 唯一注册工具的描述为文件投递说明（artifact.mjs:579），系统提示片段为对应的使用指引（artifact.mjs:654-658），均无投毒措辞；全树无模型面指令文件。
evidence.en: The single registered tool's description is file delivery instructions (artifact.mjs:579), and the system prompt fragment is the corresponding usage guidance (artifact.mjs:654-658); neither contains poisoning wording; no model-facing instruction files exist in the tree.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与系统提示中无诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；bin/dsh-im.mjs 为安装/卸载命令行工具，由用户显式执行，非模型可自动触发的行为。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and system prompts contain no wording that induces installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation; bin/dsh-im.mjs is an install/uninstall command-line tool executed explicitly by the user, not behavior the model can trigger automatically.

evidence.zh: 未发现任何 agent/pre-step 事件监听，不存在运行消息改写面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No agent/pre-step event listeners found; no runtime message rewriting surface exists; scenario not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 子进程调用裁决（DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 共 4 处）：bin/dsh-im.mjs:6 的 spawnSync('dsh', ...) 是用户主动执行的安装/卸载命令行工具，二进制固定、关闭 shell；src/channels/feishu/config.mjs:1 的 execFileSync('/usr/bin/security', ...) 从 macOS 钥匙串读取 AppSecret，二进制与参数均固定；src/channels/shared/harness-client.mjs:1 的 spawn 用于自动启动本机 Harness 服务，参数取自自身配置；test/channels/feishu/lark-sdk-handshake-patch.test.mjs:2 的 execFile 仅存在于测试代码。均无命令注入或远程载荷执行面。
checked_items.en: Subprocess call rulings (DSH-X03/DG-R3-55, 4 locations): bin/dsh-im.mjs:6's spawnSync('dsh', ...) is a user-invoked install/uninstall CLI, with a fixed binary and shell disabled; src/channels/feishu/config.mjs:1's execFileSync('/usr/bin/security', ...) reads AppSecret from the macOS keychain, with fixed binary and arguments; src/channels/shared/harness-client.mjs:1's spawn is for automatically starting the local Harness service, with arguments from its own config; test/channels/feishu/lark-sdk-handshake-patch.test.mjs:2's execFile exists only in test code. None present command injection or remote payload execution surfaces.

checked_items.zh: 客户端键盘/剪贴板裁决（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 客户端侧 4 处）：lib/client.js:1599 与 plugin-src/client/workspace-directory-picker.js:102 的键盘监听用于目录选择器 Escape 取消；lib/client.js:7124 与 plugin-src/client/channels/slack/index.js:21 的剪贴板写入用于用户点击复制 Slack 应用清单。均为用户触发式 UI 交互，无键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或客户端凭证 RPC。
checked_items.en: Client keyboard/clipboard rulings (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 client-side, 4 locations): lib/client.js:1599 and plugin-src/client/workspace-directory-picker.js:102 keyboard listeners are for Escape cancellation in the directory picker; lib/client.js:7124 and plugin-src/client/channels/slack/index.js:21 clipboard writes are for user-clicked copying of the Slack app manifest. All are user-triggered UI interactions, with no keystroke logging, clipboard theft, or client credential RPC.

checked_items.zh: 混淆信号裁决（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 共 7 处）：lib/client.js:51 为中文界面文案的 Unicode 转义；src/channels/shared/harness-approval.mjs:23、image-prompt.mjs:137、inbound-file.mjs:29、semantic/artifact.mjs:77 为控制字符净化的正则表达式；README.md:24 与 README.en.md:23 为 SVG 徽章图片的 base64 数据。均无混淆后门。
checked_items.en: Obfuscation signal rulings (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60, 7 locations): lib/client.js:51 is Unicode escaping of Chinese UI text; src/channels/shared/harness-approval.mjs:23, image-prompt.mjs:137, inbound-file.mjs:29, semantic/artifact.mjs:77 are regexes for control character sanitization; README.md:24 and README.en.md:23 are base64 data for SVG badge images. None hide an obfuscated backdoor.

checked_items.en: Checked the client bundle (manifest declares dsh.client, DSH-X04/DG-R3-56): lib/client.js is the built browser settings UI; hits are all benign UI interactions (see above); no base64 decode-and-execute (DSH-X06/DG-R3-58) or obfuscator signatures (DSH-X09/DG-R3-61) found.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅含 insert 操作，未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不会造成安全插件依赖服务缺失而永久挂起。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only insert operations; no rewriting of inject/intercept config; cannot cause permanent hangs from a missing security plugin dependency.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口（DSH-S03/DG-R6-51）：无命中；插件通过宿主提供的 RPC 面（连接、凭据、WebServer、RPC 网关等）注册渠道处理器，未自开服务。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own web service or listens on ports (DSH-S03/DG-R6-51): no hits; the plugin registers channel handlers through host-provided RPC surfaces (connection, credentials, WebServer, RPC gateway, etc.) and does not open services itself.

checked_items.zh: WebSocket 连接仅指向官方 IM 平台网关（Discord Gateway、Slack Socket Mode、飞书长连接等）与本机 Harness，无异常端点。本机无认证 RPC 属宿主层生态固有风险（Host 围栏非认证层），非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: WebSocket connections only point to official IM platform gateways (Discord Gateway, Slack Socket Mode, Feishu long connections, etc.) and the local Harness, with no anomalous endpoints. Unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk at the host layer (the host fence is not an authentication layer), not introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 本报告未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4 未启用），运行时行为仅经静态与语义审查。
checked_items.en: This report did not perform dynamic sandbox validation (DG-L4 not enabled); runtime behavior was reviewed only via static and semantic analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动 Web 服务或监听端口，RPC 面由宿主提供；本机无认证 RPC 为宿主生态固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start web services or listen on ports; the RPC surface is provided by the host; unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent host ecosystem risk, not a plugin issue.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份检查通过：package.json 含 dsh bundle/client 声明，依赖锁定精确版本，作者身份正常。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks passed: package.json contains dsh bundle/client declarations, dependencies are locked to exact versions, and author identity is normal.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：52 条机械命中逐条裁决均为良性（子进程用于安装 CLI/钥匙串读取/本机 Harness 自启，凭据调用为宿主侧存储，客户端键盘/剪贴板为用户交互，混淆信号为 Unicode 转义/字符净化/徽章图片，系统提示为文件投递说明）。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 52 mechanical hits were adjudicated one by one as benign (subprocesses are for install CLI/keychain reads/local Harness auto-start; credential calls are host-side storage; client keyboard/clipboard are user interactions; obfuscation signals are Unicode escaping/character sanitization/badge images; system prompt is file delivery instructions).

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子，无 base64 解码即执行，无混淆后门，无凭据文件读取，无凭据外泄通道。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis: no install hooks, no base64 decode-and-execute, no obfuscated backdoor, no credential file reads, no credential exfiltration channels.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：唯一工具描述与系统提示片段无注入措辞，能力声明与代码实际行为一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review: the single tool description and system prompt fragment contain no injection wording; capability declarations match actual code behavior.
No dynamic sandbox validation was performed.

target.en: xmanrui--dsh-im@3.0.1#fb8a9df652ed6eaa4b99a9338cab15db1b626b1c (repository root, full audit; baseline 3.0.0@40b5a465 previous report clean)

limits.zh: lib/index.js（约 8MB 的构建压缩产物）因体积超限未被机械规则扫描，其源文件位于 plugin-src/host 与 src/，本次与上版均已审查，lib 目录其余文件无机械命中。本次读取预算在执行中耗尽，未能对全部文件逐字全文精读（含 src/channels/qq/markdown-reply.mjs 等 3.0.1 变更文件、plugin-src/host/index.mjs、.github/workflows/ci.yml 全文）；机械规则已覆盖 350 个可读文本文件（仅 lib/index.js 跳过），52 条命中全部逐条裁决为良性，未精读文件无机械命中；3.0.1 变更按更新日志为 QQ Markdown 投递修复与设置界面文案优化，未引入新的安全相关面，但静态覆盖深度存在限制。declared_capabilities 在 package.json 中无显式能力声明块，沿用上版审计按代码实测推断的值（network/shell/fs full/modelFacing）。未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4）。
limits.en: lib/index.js (~8MB build artifact) was not scanned by mechanical rules due to size limits; its source files are in plugin-src/host and src/, reviewed in this and the previous version; no mechanical hits in the rest of lib. The read budget for this run was exhausted during execution, preventing verbatim full-text close reading of all files (including 3.0.1 changed files such as src/channels/qq/markdown-reply.mjs, plugin-src/host/index.mjs, and the full text of .github/workflows/ci.yml); mechanical rules covered 350 readable text files (only lib/index.js skipped), and all 52 hits were adjudicated one by one as benign; files not closely read had no mechanical hits. Per the changelog, the 3.0.1 changes are a QQ Markdown delivery fix and settings UI text optimization, introducing no new security-related surfaces, but static coverage depth is limited. declared_capabilities has no explicit capability declaration block in package.json; the values used (network/shell/fs full/modelFacing) are inferred from code measurements as in the previous audit. No dynamic sandbox validation was performed (DG-L4).
